lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Good evening. Welcome to Le Petit Bistro. Do you have a reservation?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, it's under Mares. A table for two, please.

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Here are your menus. May I tell you about the chef's special?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Please do. I have a food allergy. May I ask a question?

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Of course. What ingredient are you concerned about?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: I'm allergic to peanuts. Is the sauce safe?

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: I'll check with the chef. Would you like sparkling water while you wait?
